name: io.github.Servosity/eset-protect-mcp
title: ESET MCP
description: Every ESET Connect endpoint, plus per-customer health, exposure and QBR reports from a local mirror

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Email of the dedicated ESET Connect API user.

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the ESET Connect API user; exchanged for a one-hour bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Optional: tenant data center, eu, de, us, ca or jpn (default eu).

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: pre-minted bearer token; used instead of the email and password. Leave unset.

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: route every call through this proxy or test server. Leave unset.

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends.

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 so the MCP server runs read tools and GET endpoints only.

environmentVariables.name: ESET_PROTECT_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by stdio.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector (no tenant-gated profiles); leave unset. It does not limit access.
